title: Affine quasi-coherent stalks are tensor products of sections with the stalk ring
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], G a quasi-coherent O_Y-module [pqf-def-coherent], V an affine open of Y, and x a point of V. Put A=O_Y(V), M=G(V), and B=O_Y,x. Give M the section-module action restricted along the equal-open identity appLE, and B the A-algebra structure induced by the germ homomorphism A -> B. Then B tensor_A M is linearly equivalent over B to the module stalk G_x [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 01IA (lemma-quasi-coherent-affine) and 01HV (lemma-spec-sheaves), items (6), (7); affine localization step of Tag 01U4 (2) to (1); Tag 00DK (lemma-tensor-localization)

proof.text: The equal-open identity appLE is the identity homomorphism (Scheme.id_app and presheaf.map_id); rewrite its restricted Module instance to the ordinary section action. Define the A-linear germ map f into the stalk with its actual germ scalar action. Set S to the complement of the prime of x, using primeIdealOf and fromSpec_primeIdealOf.
The stalk ring is the localization of O(V) at S by IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk, so every s in S has unit germ and acts bijectively on the module stalk.

Represent a stalk vector by a germ on W and shrink to a basic open D(g) containing x. Use exists_map_eq_pow_smul_of_isAffineOpen to extend the restricted section after multiplying by a power of g. Because x lies in D(g), g belongs to S, giving the surjectivity axiom of IsLocalizedModule. For equal germs shrink their equality to D(g); exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen kills the difference by a power of g, giving the equality axiom.

The stalk A-module action is restriction along the germ homomorphism, so IsScalarTower A O_x G_x follows by reflexivity on algebraMap scalars. Apply Mathlib IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange and IsBaseChange.equiv to the proved localization axioms. The equivalence sends b tensor m to b times germ(m); the localization fraction inverse is m/s -> (1/s) tensor m.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_sections_stalk_tensor_presentation {Y : Scheme.{u}} (G : Y.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G] (V : Y.affineOpens) (x : Y)
    (hx : x ∈ V.1) :
    letI : Module Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) :=
      Module.compHom _ ((𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y).appLE V.1 V.1 (le_rfl)).hom
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V.1) (Y.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk Y.presheaf ⟨x, hx⟩
    Nonempty (TensorProduct Γ(Y, V.1) (Y.presheaf.stalk x) Γ(G, V.1)
      ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk x]
        (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace x).obj G)
